name: bookhive
description: Manage bookings for spas, salons and barbershops: check the calendar, find open slots, and book, move or cancel appointments with confirmation.

interface.longDescription:
BookHive is booking and business software for spas, salons and barbershops in Latin America. Connect your BookHive account to see today's bookings, find open slots for a service, look up clients, check the day's sales, and create, reschedule or cancel appointments.

Every change is shown to you first and only happens after you confirm it. The assistant can only do what your BookHive role allows: a receptionist sees the whole calendar, while a stylist or therapist sees only their own bookings. You can disconnect it at any time in BookHive under Configuración → Asistentes de IA.

Requires a BookHive business account.
